facts: Borders Guatemala, El Salvador and Nicaragua
worth_knowing: It reaches the Pacific at the Gulf of Fonseca and the Caribbean Sea at the Gulf of Honduras. In 1960 the northern Mosquito Coast was transferred from Nicaragua to Honduras.
